quiz_title: Web Design - Quiz 6: Positioning & Visual Animations

questions.q: Which position locks an element to a fixed spot relative to the viewport window?
questions.exp: position: fixed; sticks elements (like sticky headers) to screen borders, ignoring page scroll moves!

questions.q: What rule defines the visual states of a CSS animation at specific percentage timeline frames?
questions.exp: The @keyframes rule declares what elements look like at points along the timeline (e.g. 0%, 50%, 100%)!

questions.q: How do you loop a CSS animation infinitely?
questions.exp: Setting animation-iteration-count: infinite; makes your graphic spin, pulse, or move forever!

questions.q: What is the correct syntax for adding a drop-shadow glow to text?
questions.exp: text-shadow accepts horizontal offset (2px), vertical offset (2px), blur (5px), and color (red)!

questions.q: How do you load Font Awesome icons into a web page?
opts: Linking the CDN inside <head> and using <i> class tags
Copy pasting the SVG files inside <p>
questions.exp: Link the CDN inside head, and use class tags like <i class="fas fa-fire"></i>!
